Definition: to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.)
BiblicalUsage: Badal means to divide — to separate, distinguish, and set apart. God divided the light from the darkness on the first day, he divided the waters from the waters, he separated the Levites from the children of Israel, and he commanded Israel to be separate from the peoples of the lands. The same word that made the world also made his people.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe division is God's first work and his lasting work: he divided light from darkness at creation, and he divides his people from the world by holiness. I hold that separation is not narrowness — it is the shape of being his.
